output.markdown:
## Thanksgiving holiday drove 45.5% trip drop; weather and data quality ruled out

Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 fell 45.5% versus the mean of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024 (77,244 trips vs. baseline average of 141,642). The drop coincides with Thanksgiving, a federal holiday confirmed by us_holidays. Weather on 28 Nov (21.8 mm rain, 9.4 °C) was not the primary driver: a baseline Thursday with heavier rain (39.9 mm on 21 Nov) showed normal trip volumes (153,149). Data on 28 Nov is complete with no nulls or outliers. Average trip distance rose sharply (from ~4.3 km baseline to 9.47 km) while average fare decreased (from ~28.6 USD to 25.3 USD), indicating a shift toward longer but cheaper rides, likely airport flat-fares. Zone-level analysis was not possible due to aggregated data only.

**Recommendation:** Attribute the trip drop primarily to Thanksgiving holiday effects; monitor future holiday Thursdays for similar magnitude drops. Investigate airport trip share if raw trip-level data becomes available to test the fare mix shift hypothesis. Do not attribute the drop to weather or data quality issues.

### Evidence-backed claims
1. Trips on 2024-11-28 were -45.5% vs the mean of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024 [Q1 · sha256:95541584300b4203 · whybot.yellow_daily]
2. 2024-11-28 is a federal holiday (Thanksgiving) while baseline Thursdays are not holidays [Q2 · sha256:06448da3dbcc023e · whybot.yellow_daily]; [Q2 · sha256:06448da3dbcc023e · whybot.us_holidays]; [Q2 · sha256:06448da3dbcc023e · TPCDS_DB.date_dim]
3. Weather on 2024-11-28 was not the primary driver of the trip drop; a baseline Thursday with heavier rain (39.9 mm on 21 Nov) showed normal trip volumes [Q3 · sha256:a6bbd496f1ff6f60 · whybot.yellow_daily]; [Q3 · sha256:a6bbd496f1ff6f60 · whybot.nyc_weather_daily]; [Q3 · sha256:a6bbd496f1ff6f60 · whybot.us_holidays]; [Q3 · sha256:a6bbd496f1ff6f60 · TPCDS_DB.date_dim]
4. Data on 2024-11-28 is complete with no nulls or extreme outliers; trips=77,244, avg_total_amount=25.32, avg_trip_distance=9.47 are all present and within plausible ranges [Q4 · sha256:e98d11ad4c1176ca · whybot.yellow_daily]
5. avg_trip_distance increased from baseline average ~4.3 km to 9.47 km on 2024-11-28, while avg_total_amount decreased from baseline average ~28.61 USD to 25.32 USD, indicating a fare mix shift toward longer but cheaper rides [Q6 · sha256:75cc41a65b385c7c · whybot.yellow_daily]
6. Zone-level analysis could not be performed; yellow_daily provides only aggregated metrics without trip-level zone detail [Q7 · sha256:fa6262d344cbc54a · whybot.yellow_daily]

### Caveats
- Baseline average computed from three prior Thursdays (2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21); different baseline windows could yield slightly different percentages.
- Weather co-occurrence with holiday: rain on 28 Nov (21.8 mm) occurred alongside Thanksgiving, but heavier rain on 21 Nov did not suppress trips, so isolated weather effect cannot be fully ruled out.
- Zone-level analysis was untested due to catalog limitations; the fare mix shift hypothesis remains plausible but not proven at zone level.
- Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 3 date(s): 2024-10-14: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Columbus Day (national holiday); 2024-11-11: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Veterans Day (national holiday); 2024-11-28: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Thanksgiving Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:ff7eddb0f4eb3255].
